facts.claim: The Census counts living rooms, bedrooms, dining, drawing and study rooms as dwelling rooms, but not kitchens, bathrooms, store rooms, passages or verandahs.
facts.source_title: Census of India 2011: Instruction Manual for Houselisting and Housing Census
facts.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
facts.quote: Do not include kitchen, bathroom, latrine, store room, passageway and verandah. Include living room, bedroom, dining room, drawing room, study room, servant's room and other similar rooms.

facts.claim: Amravati (IMD station 42937) receives 763.1 mm of rain a year on average over 41.4 rainy days (1991–2020).
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: At Amravati, June to September bring 661.1 mm, about 87% of the annual rain; the wettest month is July with 205.6 mm.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)
facts.quote: STATION : AMRAVATI (index 42937) ... monthly totals JUN 137.5, JUL 205.6, AUG 179.1, SEP 138.9, OCT 47.5

facts.claim: At Amravati, morning (08:30) relative humidity averages 85% in July and 88% in August; evening (17:30) humidity is lowest in May at 31%.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)
facts.quote: STATION : AMRAVATI (index 42937) ... JUL I RH 85 ... AUG I RH 88 ... MAY II RH 31

facts.claim: May is the hottest month at Amravati, with an average daily maximum of 41.6 °C.
